Model-estimated indicators by land cover under three conditionings. A is the population the thesis currently reports. B and C condition on model-detected fire; because detection rates differ sharply between classes (nb11_t04), B and C are a severity-biased sample of the burned landscape, most strongly in the classes the model detects least well. Note also that recurrence in B and C is bounded below by 0.2 by construction, since conditioning on at least one detected month forces min(count/5, 1) >= 0.2; the recurrence column is therefore not comparable across conditionings and is reported only to make that artefact visible. Unburned sample pixels carry weight 53.3 in C; burned pixels carry weight 1.
